summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, reporting the Supervisory Board's appointment of Cassie McLean as a Management Board member and CEO of the Care Delivery segment, effective August 1, 2026. McLean, who joined the company in August 2025 as President of Fresenius Kidney Care, succeeds Craig Cordola, whose departure is acknowledged with thanks. The reshaped role aims to strengthen operational accountability. No deal terms are disclosed. Watch for operational execution and performance under McLean's leadership.
